title: Micropip Dependency Check
text:
This page tries to install the hosted mcqpy_core and mcqpy_shiny wheels with micropip.install(..., keep_going=True) so the browser shows the full missing-wheel set instead of stopping at the first dependency failure.
#| '!! shinylive warning !!': |
#|   shinylive does not work in self-contained HTML documents.
#|   Please set `embed-resources: false` in your metadata.
#| standalone: true
## file: app.py
from shiny import App, reactive, render, ui

WHEEL_URLS = [
    "https://au-mbg.github.io/mcqpy/wheels/mcqpy_core-0.1.0-py3-none-any.whl",
    "https://au-mbg.github.io/mcqpy/wheels/mcqpy_shiny-0.1.0-py3-none-any.whl",
]

app_ui = ui.page_fluid(
    ui.h2("Micropip dependency check"),
    ui.p("Installing these wheel URLs with keep_going=True:"),
    ui.tags.ul(*[ui.tags.li(url) for url in WHEEL_URLS]),
    ui.output_text_verbatim("status"),
)


def server(input, output, session):
    status = reactive.value("Starting dependency check...")
    started = reactive.value(False)

    @reactive.effect
    async def _install():
        if started.get():
            return
        started.set(True)

        import traceback
        import micropip

        try:
            await micropip.install(WHEEL_URLS, keep_going=True)
            status.set("Installation completed without errors.")
        except Exception:
            status.set(traceback.format_exc())

    @render.text
    def status():
        return status.get()


app = App(app_ui, server)

title: MCQPy Web
text:
This page embeds the MCQPy Shinylive quiz app using a generated wheel-based include.
The include is produced with mcqpy_shiny.embed_cli, which emits a small Shinylive app wrapper plus a requirements.txt that installs mcqpy-shiny from a published wheel.
The preview site is published under /shiny/, while the wheel artifacts are published under /wheels/ on the same Pages deployment.
#| '!! shinylive warning !!': |
#|   shinylive does not work in self-contained HTML documents.
#|   Please set `embed-resources: false` in your metadata.
#| standalone: true
## file: app.py
from mcqpy_shiny.embed_app import create_app

app = create_app(
    fixed_url=None,
    fixed_token=None,
    allow_manual_load=True,
    title='MCQPy Quiz',
    card_width='900px',
)
